props.description:
This table lists work orders and it's attributes
Links out to transfer order line, work order process, work order process  distribution and, work order process BOM

fields.name: number
fields.description: Label field, and the number of the Work Order.
fields.label: Number

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The desired output quantity for the overall Work Order.
fields.label: Quantity

fields.name: earliestStartAt
fields.description: Earliest Start Date/Time represents the earliest feasible date that this Work Order can be started because MRP has determined the material availability.
fields.label: Earliest Start Date

fields.name: promiseAt
fields.description: The Date/Time of the overall Work Order - this field describes the general Due Date, or Date upon which you expect all inventory to be available pertaining to this Work Order. Also considered to be a proposed Due Date.
fields.label: Due Date

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: A link to a record from an external system.
fields.label: External Id

props.label: Scheduled Start Date

props.description: Only display workcenters which have work orders assigned.

events.__transform:
[data.workOrderProcessDistribution.edges.node ~> | $ | ( { "name": workOrderProcess.productStrategy.product.number & " - Qty " & requiredQuantity, "eventColor": $coalesce([ workOrderProcessDistributionStatus.color, "light-gray" ]), "tooltipHtml": 'Work Order: ' & workOrderProcess.workOrder.number & '
' & '  ' & workOrderProcess.workOrder.quantity & ' of ' & workOrderProcess.productStrategy.product.number & ' due by ' & $moment(workOrderProcess.workOrder.promiseAt).format('L') & '
' & '  Priority: ' & " " & workOrderProcess.workOrder.workOrderPriority.name & '
' & 'Process: ' & workOrderProcess.order & ' (' & workOrderProcess.process.code & ')
' & '  Status: ' & " " & workOrderProcessDistributionStatus.name & '
' & '  Scheduled: ' & ( startDate ? $moment(startDate).format('L LT') : '?' ) & ' - ' & ( endDate ? $moment(endDate).format('L LT') : '?' ) & '
' & '  Primary Workcenter: ' & workOrderProcess.productStrategyProcess.workcenter.code & '
' & '  Alternate Workcenters: ' & $join(workOrderProcess.productStrategyProcess.alternateWorkcenters.edges.node.workcenter.code, ',
    ') & '
', "eventHtml": '
' & workOrderProcess.workOrder.number & ' ' & workOrderProcess.productStrategy.product.number & '
' & 'Qty ' & requiredQuantity & '
', "unscheduledLabel": $isNilOrEmpty(startDate) ? "Unscheduled" : undefined, "allowedResourceIds": $flatten([ workOrderProcess.productStrategyProcess.workcenter.id, workOrderProcess.productStrategyProcess.alternateWorkcenters.edges.node.workcenter.id ]) } ) |]

props.label: Units / Hour:
props.description: The standard rate represents the typically expected production rate at this workcenter. Taking into account typical downtime, material shortages, etc. This rate is used for planning purposes, but not used for OEE calculations. This is always Inventory Unit Per Hour of production.
